title: policy.yaml
description: A verdict policy passed to `evidence verdict` (--policy). TOOL INPUT, not pack contract — it lives beside the versioned 0.1/ tree and is never written into a pack. A policy is a named list of gates; each gate either compares one metric against a threshold or evaluates a boolean CEL expression. Unknown keys are rejected so a typo'd operator fails loudly. See decisions 0047 and 0049.

policy.description: Policy id, echoed in the verdict and used as the verdict file name (<policy>.verdict.json), so it is file-name safe.

requires.description: Optional: refuse packs whose metric catalog is a different producer catalog, or a version outside `version`. A pack without a catalog fails this requirement.

catalog.description: The catalog id the pack must carry (meta/metrics-catalog.yaml `catalog`).

version.description: Space-separated comparators over the catalog version, e.g. ">=1", ">=1 <4", "3". Versions compare numerically by dot-separated segment.

gate.description: One check. A metric gate names a metric and exactly one operator; an expression gate carries `expr` (a CEL expression that must evaluate to a bool) and no operator.

id.description: Gate id, unique within the policy.

metric.description: A built-in metric (evidence-core, unprefixed, e.g. totals.failed) or a producer metric from the pack's catalog (always metrics.<name>).

expr.description: A CEL expression over the pack facts that must evaluate to a bool (decision 0049).

where.description: A CEL expression over one test (`test`) that narrows a per-test metric to the tests it holds for. Only on metric gates whose metric is per_test.

equals.description: Pass when the metric equals this value.

min.description: Pass when the metric is >= this value.

max.description: Pass when the metric is <= this value.

in.description: Pass when the metric is one of these values.

severity.description: blocking: a failure fails the verdict. warning: a failure is reported but does not fail it. An errored gate errors the verdict whatever its severity.

message.description: Optional human message, echoed in the gate result.
